response.original_title: Amityville vs. The Galactic Samurai Schoolgirls
response.overview: When mysterious lights appear over Amityville, three clueless Long Island dudes stumble into a full-blown alien invasion — led by a trio of seductive, sword-wielding Galactic Samurai Schoolgirls sent to Earth to complete their brutal (and horny) training mission. As samurai blades clash with guns, bad decisions, and even worse dialogue, the night erupts into a delirious mash-up of sci-fi sleaze, drive-in horror, and fourth-wall-breaking comedy!
